description: Onboarding backend + webhook authenticity. Add the Embedded Signup (Path A) and manual-credential (Path B) endpoints that validate against Meta before persisting and store the encrypted per-tenant token via upsertNumberForUser, and harden the existing webhook with X-Hub-Signature-256 verification plus strict per-tenant inbound routing (removing the misattributing env/'any verified' fallback). Depends on FEAT-001 (crypto + whatsapp helpers + schema fields). Does not touch the send paths or frontend.
steps: Create src/app/api/numbers/embedded-signup/route.ts (POST). Auth-guard with getServerSession(authOptions) (401 without session.user.id); scope writes to session.user.id. zod body { code: string(1..4000), phoneNumberId?: string(1..100), wabaId?: string(1..100) }. Per design §4.2: require META_APP_ID + META_APP_SECRET else 500 (log key name only); exchange code via GET https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/oauth/access_token?client_id&client_secret&code (NO redirect_uri) -> capture access_token + expires_in (tokenExpiresAt = now + expires_in*1000, else null); resolve wabaId (body value first; else GET /v19.0/debug_token with defensive `data?.data?.granular_scopes ?? []` -> entry.scope === 'whatsapp_business_management' -> entry?.target_ids?.[0]; if still none -> terminal 400); discover phoneNumberId via GET /v19.0/{wabaId}/phone_numbers if absent (none -> 400); fetch health GET /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,status (non-OK -> 400 with Meta message, nothing saved); POST /v19.0/{wabaId}/subscribed_apps (non-fatal, log outcome); POST /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}/register with a random 6-digit pin — advisory only, NEVER fails onboarding on any result, detect already-registered via numeric error.code === 133016 (never message text); guard empty normalizePhone(display_phone_number) -> 400 'Could not read the number's display phone from Meta'; encrypt(businessToken) and upsertNumberForUser({ userId, phoneNumber, data }) with data = { connectionType: 'embedded_signup', wabaId, phoneNumberId, accessToken: ciphertext, tokenExpiresAt, displayPhoneNumber, verifiedName, qualityRating, codeVerificationStatus, platformType, verificationStatus: 'verified', verifiedAt: new Date() }; map NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError -> 409 'This number is connected to another account'; respond serializeNumber(record). Never log tokens. All fetch to Graph v19.0.

Create src/app/api/numbers/manual/route.ts (POST). Auth-guard + scope to session.user.id. zod body { wabaId: string(1..100), phoneNumberId: string(1..100), accessToken: string(10..5000), label?: string(0..100) }. Per design §5.2: validate live GET /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,status with Authorization: Bearer providedToken — non-OK -> 400 with Meta's error.message, NOTHING saved; three-way WABA tie-check GET /v19.0/{wabaId}/phone_numbers — (a) list OK and phoneNumberId present -> proceed; (b) list OK and absent -> fatal 400 'This phone number is not under the provided WhatsApp Business Account', nothing saved; (c) list call fails -> non-fatal warn (step 1 authoritative); POST /v19.0/{wabaId}/subscribed_apps non-fatal; empty normalizePhone(display_phone_number) -> 400 guard; encrypt(providedToken) + upsertNumberForUser(...) with data = { connectionType: 'manual', wabaId, phoneNumberId, accessToken: ciphertext, tokenExpiresAt: null, displayPhoneNumber, verifiedName, qualityRating, codeVerificationStatus, platformType, verificationStatus: 'verified', verifiedAt: new Date() }; NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError -> 409; respond serializeNumber(record) (no token). Never log/echo the token.

Modify src/app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts. Keep GET handshake exactly as is. In POST: add `import crypto from "crypto"`; read `const raw = await request.text()` BEFORE any JSON parse, then JSON.parse(raw). Signature verification per design §8 step 2, each failure returning 401 and processing nothing: (1) if !process.env.META_APP_SECRET -> 401 + console.error naming the missing key; (2) read X-Hub-Signature-256; if missing or not starting with 'sha256=' -> 401; slice the hex; (3) ourHex = crypto.createHmac('sha256', META_APP_SECRET).update(raw, 'utf8').digest('hex'); (4) build Buffers a=Buffer.from(theirHex,'hex'), b=Buffer.from(ourHex,'hex'); if a.length !== b.length -> 401 (avoids timingSafeEqual throw); else if !crypto.timingSafeEqual(a,b) -> 401. After a valid signature: keep the status mapping (updateMany where metaMessageId -> status/deliveredAt/readAt/errorMessage); for inbound, resolve the owning WhatsAppNumber STRICTLY by value.metadata.phone_number_id (findFirst where phoneNumberId) and write message/conversation under that row's real userId; if NO row matches, console.log the unmatched phone_number_id and skip (create nothing). REMOVE the env META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID fallback and the 'any verified number' fallback entirely. Post-signature processing errors still return 200. Never log the secret/HMAC/tokens.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with the two new route files and the modified webhook type-checking (AC #1).
Webhook GET with hub.mode=subscribe + matching META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN returns the exact hub.challenge with 200; a wrong token returns 403 and does not echo (AC #3, #4).

Webhook POST with a missing/invalid X-Hub-Signature-256 is rejected with 401 and creates no message/conversation rows; a POST with a valid HMAC signature over the raw body and a status payload updates the matching Message by metaMessageId (deliveredAt/readAt/errorMessage) (AC #5, #6).

Manual path: the handler validates against Meta BEFORE any DB write so invalid credentials return 400 with Meta's message and create no row/token; the success response passes through serializeNumber and contains neither plaintext nor ciphertext token (AC #7, #8).
Inbound webhook routing resolves owner strictly by phone_number_id (no env/'any verified' fallback), so a payload for tenant A's phone_number_id can only create rows under tenant A's userId (AC #13).
verification: Webhook GET handshake via curl: matching verify token -> exact hub.challenge/200; wrong token -> 403 (needs runtime verification — exercise with a local META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN).

Webhook POST signature: sign a crafted raw status payload with HMAC-SHA256 using a local test META_APP_SECRET -> matching Message updated by metaMessageId; send with a missing/invalid signature -> 401 and no rows created (needs runtime verification with a local secret).

Read the compiled manual + embedded-signup handlers to confirm validate-before-persist ordering, zod rejection of invalid bodies, 409 on NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError, and that responses go through serializeNumber (live Meta OAuth/validation is needs-runtime-verification with user-supplied Config ID/token — do NOT dismiss as already-working from code alone).
findings:
COMPLETED. Three deliverables, Graph v19.0 everywhere, no tokens/secrets logged.

NEW src/app/api/numbers/embedded-signup/route.ts (POST, Path A):
- Auth: getServerSession(authOptions) -> 401 without session.user.id; writes scoped to session.user.id.
- zod bodySchema: { code: string(1..4000), phoneNumberId?: string(1..100), wabaId?: string(1..100) }; safeParse -> 400 (with error.flatten() details) BEFORE any Meta call.
- META_APP_ID + META_APP_SECRET required else 500 (console.error names the key names only, never values).
- OAuth exchange: GET /v19.0/oauth/access_token?client_id&client_secret&code (NO redirect_uri). tokenExpiresAt = now + expires_in*1000 when expires_in is a number, else null.
- wabaId resolution: body value first; else GET /v19.0/debug_token (input_token=access_token=businessToken) with defensive data?.data?.granular_scopes ?? [] -> entry.scope === 'whatsapp_business_management' -> entry?.target_ids?.[0]; still none -> 400.
- phoneNumberId discovery: body first; else GET /v19.0/{wabaId}/phone_numbers -> data[0].id; none -> 400.
- Health: GET /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}?fields=display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,code_verification_status,platform_type,status; non-OK -> 400 with Meta error.message, nothing saved.
- POST /v19.0/{wabaId}/subscribed_apps (non-fatal, logs status). POST /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}/register with random 6-digit pin — advisory only, NEVER fails onboarding; detects already-registered via numeric regData.error.code === 133016 (not message text).
- normalizePhone(display_phone_number) empty -> 400 "Could not read the number's display phone from Meta".
- encrypt(businessToken) then upsertNumberForUser with connectionType 'embedded_signup', verificationStatus 'verified', verifiedAt now, all Meta health fields. NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError -> 409 'This number is connected to another account'. Response = serializeNumber(record), 201.

NEW src/app/api/numbers/manual/route.ts (POST, Path B):
- Auth + scope same as above. zod: { wabaId: string(1..100), phoneNumberId: string(1..100), accessToken: string(10..5000), label?: string(0..100) } -> 400 on fail.
- Validate-before-persist: GET /v19.0/{phoneNumberId}?fields=... with Authorization: Bearer providedToken; non-OK -> 400 with Meta error.message, NOTHING saved.
- Three-way WABA tie-check GET /v19.0/{wabaId}/phone_numbers: (a) OK + phoneNumberId present -> proceed; (b) OK + absent -> fatal 400 'This phone number is not under the provided WhatsApp Business Account'; (c) call fails -> non-fatal warn (health check authoritative).
- POST subscribed_apps non-fatal. normalizePhone empty -> 400 guard. encrypt(providedToken) + upsertNumberForUser connectionType 'manual', tokenExpiresAt null, verificationStatus 'verified', verifiedAt now. 409 on cross-tenant. Response serializeNumber(record), 201. Token never logged/echoed.

TYPE NOTE for later features calling upsertNumberForUser: the helper's data param type is (WhatsAppNumberUncheckedUpdateInput & WhatsAppNumberUncheckedCreateInput); the CreateInput half requires userId+phoneNumber which the helper injects itself, so a plain object literal fails typecheck. Both routes cast the data literal `as Prisma.WhatsAppNumberUncheckedUpdateInput & Prisma.WhatsAppNumberUncheckedCreateInput` (import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client'). Reuse this pattern in FEAT-003 send/health routes.

MODIFIED src/app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts:
- GET handshake unchanged (subscribe + META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN -> echo challenge/200; else 403).
- POST: `import crypto from 'crypto'`; raw = await request.text() BEFORE JSON.parse(raw). Signature gate, each failure -> 401 (new Response('Unauthorized',{status:401})) processing nothing: (1) !META_APP_SECRET -> 401 + console.error naming the key; (2) X-Hub-Signature-256 missing or not starting 'sha256=' -> 401, else slice hex; (3) ourHex = HMAC-SHA256(secret).update(raw,'utf8').digest('hex'); (4) a=Buffer.from(theirHex,'hex'), b=Buffer.from(ourHex,'hex'); a.length!==b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a,b) -> 401 (length guard avoids timingSafeEqual throw).
- Status mapping preserved (updateMany where metaMessageId -> status/deliveredAt/readAt/errorMessage).
- Inbound routing now STRICT: resolve owning WhatsAppNumber by findFirst({ where: { phoneNumberId: value.metadata.phone_number_id } }) ONLY. REMOVED the META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID env fallback AND the 'any verified number' fallback. No match -> console.log the unmatched phone_number_id and continue (creates nothing). Rows written under resolvedNumber.userId. Post-signature processing errors still return 200 so Meta won't retry.

VERIFICATION:
- `npm run build` passes clean (both new routes appear as dynamic lambdas; webhook recompiled). Initial build caught the upsert data type gap; fixed via the Prisma cast noted above.
- Live runtime exercise against `next start` on :3999 with META_APP_SECRET=testsecret123, META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN=verifytok123: GET correct token -> 200 + exact 'CHALLENGE_42' echo; GET wrong token -> 403 'Forbidden' (no echo); POST no header -> 401; POST invalid sig -> 401; POST valid-hex-but-wrong-prefix(missing 'sha256=') -> 401; POST with correct 'sha256=<HMAC(raw)>' -> 200 {ok:true} and processed a status updateMany with no rows created (phone_number_id 'nope' + wamid 'wamid.TEST' matched nothing). Standalone node repro also confirmed the !META_APP_SECRET -> 401 branch and the length-guard (short hex -> 401, no throw).
- Handler-shape read confirms validate-before-persist ordering (zod -> 400, Meta health -> 400, both before encrypt/upsert), 409 on NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError, and serializeNumber on all success responses. Live Meta OAuth/validation remains needs-runtime-verification (user-supplied Config ID + App Review + real token).

STILL OPEN for later features: FEAT-003 (send paths + numbers CRUD/health using resolveSendCredentials + serializeNumber), FEAT-004 (frontend Connect UI + .env.example + scratchpad). The embedded-signup route expects the client to POST { code, phoneNumberId?, wabaId? } obtained from the Meta FB SDK popup (FEAT-004 wires that up). Required env the deployer must set: META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, ENCRYPTION_KEY, plus NEXT_PUBLIC_* + META_CONFIG_ID for the frontend.
